criteria.acceptance_exact: No-SE is explicit; missing required SE fails closed. Unsupported methods and custody modes never trigger silent downgrades.
criteria.actual_semantics_read: Custom missing/wrong/unknown/provider-failed component and custody mismatch block; manual-only accounts and explicit no-SE modes; all requested semantic mismatches refuse without writes.
criteria.execution_or_review_support: Core required_component_and_custody_never_fall_back; client profile/route controls; policy grant restrictions.
criteria.limits: Conformance profile/catalog checks do not qualify either chip, persistent storage or attached hardware.

criteria.acceptance_exact: Bridge routes by versioned methods/algorithms/limits and transport; a device claim alone is not proof of security state.
criteria.actual_semantics_read: Actual service-to-recording USB/QR drivers check route fields, expected signed identity, local limit minima, stale snapshots/hooks, response budgets, clocks and pending settlement.
criteria.execution_or_review_support: Client19method source; service H01203; actual Bridge725 old18 methods plus current focused pending-discovery1PASS/typecheck; all17 retained integration steps.
criteria.limits: Host before-write revocation is not backend authorization revocation. Recording adapters/ports and seven-page plans are synthetic, not device approval.

criteria.acceptance_exact: Keep public compatibility contracts and independent vectors common while allowing distinct timing and custody.
criteria.actual_semantics_read: One independently fixed contract/case source projects into existing tests. Cross-language/frame/SDK tests preserve version/custody differences and independent expected outputs.
criteria.execution_or_review_support: 170original mappings+5data rows+3data helpers+8vector bytecopy; root3653 fixed-input replay; root/H01 provenance and artifact-pin reviews external; actual package/Pi/integration campaigns.
criteria.limits: Mapping inventory is not execution.162 old outputs have literal Rust references;8retired status strings remain historical inventory only, with actual whole-method rejection replacing retired readiness interpretation.

criteria.acceptance_exact: Record separate capabilities for NIP-44 primitives, verified message context and usable NIP-17/59 workflows. Advertise payload/queue limits and unsupported operations without silent downgrade.
criteria.actual_semantics_read: Distinct primitive/context/named-workflow eligibility, contradictory-state rejection, exact workflow name positive and wrong-name negative. Actual unadmitted methods/DM/setup/AUTH reject before writes; finite payload/work/pending/queue constraints.
criteria.execution_or_review_support: Unchanged metadata572 and D01..04 actual helper tests; client P06/D05..07 zero-write assertions; resource layout/core and host/serial controls.
criteria.limits: D04 is synthetic eligibility only. D05/06 are routing refusals only; C02 crypto/context/relay/publication remains unavailable. L07 is host layout plus payload reservations, not exact VM heap or MCU measurement.
